say:0:1660219001:2.text: You've defeated the twins, but they're not letting go. You can clearly see the displeasure on their faces.
say:0:1660219001:2.source_cn: 双子被击败了，但是他们的想法并没有改变。你能清晰看到他...

say:0:1660219001:2.female: You've defeated the twins, but they're not letting go. You can clearly see the displeasure on their faces.

say:2:1660219002:0.text: If you leave this dream, the nightmare will come for you. Why risk that?
say:2:1660219002:0.source_cn: 梦魇会带走你们，为什么要出去？
say:2:1660219002:0.male: If you leave this dream, the nightmare will come for you. Why risk that?
say:2:1660219002:0.female: If you leave this dream, the nightmare will come for you. Why risk that?

say:3:1660219003:0.text: The real world is dangerous. In here, you're safe.
say:3:1660219003:0.source_cn: 现实真的很危险，为什么不留下？
say:3:1660219003:0.male: The real world is dangerous. In here, you're safe.
say:3:1660219003:0.female: The real world is dangerous. In here, you're safe.

choice_prompt:4:1660219003.text: The real world is dangerous. In here, you're safe.

say:7:1660219004:0.text: Good intentions don't always lead to good outcomes. Sometimes they do harm in the most destructive ways.
say:7:1660219004:0.source_cn: 有些时候，善良的念头，反倒比恶意的阴谋带来的伤害更大。

say:9:1660219005:0.text: My whole life is out there—my family, my friends, and Peggy. I'm not leaving them behind!
say:9:1660219005:0.source_cn: 我们过去的一切都从现实里来，我的家人在那里，我的朋友们...

say:11:1660219006:0.text: I-I still get nervous around people, I always have... But the Dark Forest needs me, and I'm not running from that!
say:11:1660219006:0.source_cn: 虽、虽然很害怕和陌生人接触，但是，但是薄暮丛林的大家需要我！

say:13:1660219007:0.text: Alsa is waiting for me. So is my family. I'm going home.
say:13:1660219007:0.source_cn: 阿尔萨和家人在等着，我一定要回去。

say:15:1660219008:0.source_cn: 他们真的太固执了，伊莱亚！

say:16:1660219009:0.text: They're going to get hurt, Lailah!
say:16:1660219009:0.source_cn: 他们真的会受伤的，莱拉！

say:21:1660219012:0.source_cn: 糟糕，我们的声音太大了……

say:24:1660219013:0.text: Aurora's figure begins to take shape. She yawns, rubbing her eyes like someone waking from a very long sleep.
say:24:1660219013:0.source_cn: 奥萝菈的身影渐渐浮现，她打了个哈欠，揉着眼睛看着四下的一切。

say:26:1660219015:0.text: Looks like you managed to undo the twins' little prank. These two snuck a bit of my power while I was sleeping and used it to cause trouble behind my back...
say:26:1660219015:0.source_cn: 看来你成功破除了伊莱亚和莱拉的恶作剧。这两个孩子趁我睡...
say:26:1660219015:0.male: Looks like you managed to undo the twins' little prank. These two snuck a bit of my power while I was sleeping and used it to cause trouble behind my back...
say:26:1660219015:0.female: Looks like you managed to undo the twins' little prank. These two snuck a bit of my power while I was sleeping and used it to cause trouble behind my back...

say:30:1660219018:0.text: People from different lands and different worlds all living together peacefully in a dream... That's not a bad idea, right Elijah?
say:30:1660219018:0.source_cn: 所有种族、不同文化的人，在梦境里相处如宾。这是好事，伊莱亚。

say:31:1660219019:0.text: A world without conflict, without division... It does sound like a lovely dream, Lailah.
say:31:1660219019:0.source_cn: 从此世界上再也没有差异与斗争。没有比这更棒的美梦，莱拉。

say:33:1660219020:0.text: But I did spend part of the dream being chased by a very angry debt collector...
say:33:1660219020:0.source_cn: 不过，我还是被追债人追了一路……

say:35:1660219021:0.text: And I got into a fistfight with rival tribesmen.
say:35:1660219021:0.source_cn: 我和其他部落的人打了一架。

say:36:1660219022:0.text: So... that means the great experiment didn't pan out? What a shame. It was supposed to be a beautiful and flawless story!
say:36:1660219022:0.source_cn: 尝试，失败了？这出戏剧本该温柔完美，无可挑剔！

say:37:1660219023:1.text: Where did it all go wrong? We built this story together, which means the nightmare shouldn't be here at all. It was never in the script.
say:37:1660219023:1.source_cn: 尝试，出错了？这出戏剧混入了杂质，不该有梦魇挑拨。

say:40:1660219024:0.source_cn: 哦，你已经破解了梦境中的四重诅咒……这是双子基于剧团创...

say:41:1660219025:0.text: Aurora lifts her hands. Spring rain forms a needle, and sunlight becomes a thread. Autumn dusk turns into cloth, and the wind and snow of winter spin around her.
say:41:1660219025:0.source_cn: 奥萝菈使用春之国的春雨做针，用夏之国的阳光做线，用秋之...

say:42:1660219026:0.text: As her hands move with rhythm, the four seasons weave together into a new song.

say:44:1660219027:0.text: Go on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let the whole world hear it.
say:44:1660219027:0.male: Go on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let the whole world hear it.
